name: Summit AZ - Blog - Trenchless Pipe Lining
body:
> Blog · Summit Az · 2026-06-22

# Summary
Explainer on how trenchless pipe lining (cured-in-place liner) repairs sewer and water lines from the inside with little digging, with Arizona uses (desert landscaping, pavers, mature trees, aging clay, cast iron and Orangeburg pipe). Published 2026-06-22 at `/blog/trenchless-pipe-lining/` (ID 5830). Category: Leaks and Pipes.

# Key facts
- Focus keyphrase: trenchless pipe lining. SEO title (56 chars): "Trenchless Pipe Lining: How It Works | Summit".
- Links: `/pipe-lining/` pillar, pipe lining Chandler, sewer line repair and replacement, sewer line repair Phoenix, sibling prevent-clogged-drains post, contact.
- External source: EPA retrospective evaluation of CIPP in municipal gravity sewers.
- GSC comparison (Jun vs Sep 2026) shows the post moving from position 59.4 to 23.2 while impressions fell (see [Summit AZ - Perf Tracker](lib:brain-summit-az-perf-tracker)).
- Note: later Summit posts (old cracked pipes, sewer repair or replacement) deliberately avoid "pipe lining" and "trenchless" wording; this June post predates that rule.

# Versions
- `.md`, `.html`, `_wp2\` and `_wp_new\` versions with banner and inline images.
